title: Add sham control and exclude documented temp-drift run R07
what: Clean treated lift over sham control is +6.0 a.u. (+48%, 18.5 vs 12.5 a.u.) after excluding faulty R07

reader_questions.question: What is the corrected net lift of treated over sham control after excluding R07?
